component.name: Chtra
component.summary: View photos and convert them in batches

description.p: Chtra is a fast, small photo viewer and batch converter. It opens JPEG, JPEG XL, PNG, GIF, BMP, WebP, AVIF and HEIC photos and converts whole folders between them, with resizing and renaming.

ul.li: Zoom, pan, rotate, slideshow and a thumbnail browser
Batch conversion to JPEG, JPEG XL, PNG, GIF, BMP, WebP and AVIF
Keeps EXIF data and colour profiles
Follows the light or dark style of your desktop
Works offline: no network access, no telemetry

description.p: Every decoder is written in memory-safe Rust, including the HEIC and AVIF decoders.
